races.name: Agri Day At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CINNODIN took a clear step back in the right direction in a change of headgear when fourth at Uttoxeter 3 weeks ago and may still have a bit of untapped potential as a stayer, so he receives the tentative vote. The Wise Traveller isn't getting any younger, but is only 2 lb higher than for his C&D success in May and is capable fresh.

  1. CINNODIN
  2. THE WISE TRAVELLER (IRE)
  3. INDIAN SUNBIRD (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties 2026 At Huntingdon Racecourse Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BROADWAY HONEY escapes a penalty for her impressive victory at Fontwell on Saturday and can make it 3-4 over fences for her red-hot stable. Carrigmoorna Rowan could be the danger starting out for a new trainer.

  1. BROADWAY HONEY (IRE)
  2. CARRIGMOORNA ROWAN (IRE)
  3. HUDSON (FR)

races.name: Book 2026/27 Hospitality At Huntingdon Racecourse Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A notably thin maiden and a good opportunity for the well-bred GOLDEN TIARA to get her Rules career off to the perfect start. Dancing Dame is the obvious threat.

  1. GOLDEN TIARA (IRE)
  2. DANCING DAME (IRE)
  3. RHYTHM OF LIFE (FR)

races.name: 2026/2027 Annual Badges Now On Sale At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
INCA shaped quite encouragingly on first run for his new yard when fourth at Worcester last month and could be the answer if building on that in a first-time tongue strap. Clever Relation could be the danger if not caught out by the shorter trip.

  1. INCA (FR)
  2. CLEVER RELATION
  3. SAUCATS (FR)

races.name: Host Your Conference At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DELPOTRO arrives in good form and there's every chance he could get away on the front end, especially if able to dictate, which tilts the vote in his favour over Datsalrightcharlie, who is likely to find this test on the sharp side. Mavis Pike retains potential as a chaser returning from a 10-month absence so warrants respect, particularly with the Twiston-Davies yard amongst the winners.

  1. DELPOTRO (FR)
  2. DATSALRIGHTCHARLIE (IRE)
  3. MAVIS PIKE

races.name: Advertise At Huntingdon Racecourse In 2026/2027 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLOW RIVER FLOW appeals on paper and the booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye, so he's taken to make a winning start. Snicket for last year's winning yard and Bran Galad are other likely types on breeding and need taking seriously, especially if the subject of strong market support.

  1. FLOW RIVER FLOW (IRE)
  2. SNICKET
  3. BRAN GALAD

races.name: Matchbook Signup - Get 20% Back On Losses Apprentice Handicap (Hands And Heels)
races.verdict:
JENSON BENSON has returned from an absence on good order, snapping a lengthy losing sequence here last month. He can follow up at the chief expense of Haveagobeau and Launceston.

  1. JENSON BENSON (IRE)
  2. HAVEAGOBEAU
  3. LAUNCESTON (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a strong maiden so QUEENS BANDIT is selected to build on the promise of her debut third at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. Lord Percy is also open to progress, while Tough Decision makes some appeal on pedigree.

  1. QUEENS BANDIT
  2. LORD PERCY (IRE)
  3. TOUGH DECISION

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Handicap
races.verdict:
Hard to make a compelling case for any of these but SOUTH KENSINGTON is more than capable from this mark if on a going day so is awarded the vote in the hope there's a sound pace for her to chase. Rainbow Sign and King of The Dance are potential threats.

  1. SOUTH KENSINGTON (IRE)
  2. RAINBOW SIGN
  3. KING OF THE DANCE (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Something of a repeat of last month's C&D contest with the first 4 on that occasion all back in opposition. Highland Harvey was second that day but is fancied to deservedly double his tally. With Bug Boy not sure to be in the same form this time, Clipsham Noble is feared most.

  1. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)
  2. CLIPSHAM NOBLE (IRE)
  3. BUG BOY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Monthly Bet-Builder Rebate Handicap
races.verdict:
OXFORD CIRCUS failed to meet market expectations starting out for James Owen but he did have an excuse and from this basement mark, he's well worth siding with. Berning Hot and Burford Beauty (starting out for an up-and-coming stable) are definite threats.

  1. OXFORD CIRCUS (IRE)
  2. BERNING HOT (IRE)
  3. BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Play Your Multiples at matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict:
MY MATE MACKLEY and Candy Warhol filled the first 2 positions in a C&D handicap last week and it would be no surprise were that to happen again. Beach Partee can also go well for Scott Dixon, while Everydaysasaturday needs a check in the market.

  1. MY MATE MACKLEY
  2. CANDY WARHOL (USA)
  3. BEACH PARTEE

races.name: Download The Matchbook Exchange App Handicap
races.verdict:
In the hope he can break on terms this time, DONTSPOILASALE is taken to cash in on what is a very handy mark. Diomed Spirit and Roman Spring have plenty of C&D wins between them and head the opposition.

  1. DONTSPOILASALE (IRE)
  2. DIOMED SPIRIT
  3. ROMAN SPRING (IRE)

races.name: Willpower Group Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
DASHING DICK has been cut plenty of slack by the handicapper and will appreciate the drop back in trip after a solid effort at Yarmouth last time. He makes most appeal. Shark Two One and Sir David ran well here last month and may provide the chief threat.

  1. DASHING DICK (IRE)
  2. SHARK TWO ONE
  3. SIR DAVID (FR)

races.name: Alan & Sarah Laughterloft Legends Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOODVALE did well to overcome inexperience when making a winning start at Beverley and can defy a penalty. Havana Flash is the danger back over 5f on good to firm going.

  1. WOODVALE
  2. HAVANA FLASH (IRE)
  3. PAPHOS (IRE)

races.name: Mick & Linda New Inn Enderby Cheers Nursery
races.verdict:
MA FILLE DE REVE was much improved upped to this trip when second at Thirsk 3 weeks ago and can surely win a race like this on that showing. Windsor winner Holliesthedollie and Secret Rival are a couple of the other key players.

  1. MA FILLE DE REVE
  2. HOLLIESTHEDOLLIE
  3. SECRET RIVAL (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ENGEDI left the impression she could improve significantly with her promising Beverley debut behind her and is taken to get off the mark. Caelan's Rose and Ozone Friendly are feared most.

  1. ENGEDI (IRE)
  2. CAELAN'S ROSE
  3. OZONE FRIENDLY

races.name: Everards Of Leicestershire Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing SEVEN QUESTIONS before the benefit of market clues. The 2024 Palace House winner has found life tough since landing a gamble at Goodwood in May but has dropped to a career-low mark consequently and could be set for a revival with Billy Loughnane up back at a track where he won easily on his only other visit. Forager came clear readily at Bath last week and has obvious claims under a penalty. Ziggy's Triton and Brummell are a couple of the other key players.

  1. SEVEN QUESTIONS (IRE)
  2. FORAGER
  3. ZIGGY'S TRITON (IRE)

races.name: Paul & Margo Barley Mow Cosgrove Farewell Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SOLARIZE is lightly raced for his age and added another victory to his tally at Southwell a fortnight ago. Still fairly treated, he is taken to score again. Percy's Daydream and Ruby Wedding rate the principal dangers.

  1. SOLARIZE
  2. PERCY'S DAYDREAM
  3. RUBY WEDDING

races.name: Mario & Traci Plough Duxford Last Orders Handicap
races.verdict:
MAGIC MUSIC looked unlucky not to win here a fortnight ago and can make amends. Red Snapper and Travel Agent are a couple of others to consider.

  1. MAGIC MUSIC
  2. RED SNAPPER
  3. TRAVEL AGENT (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Price Boosts Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
ZAFAAN had plenty in the tank when going in at Wolverhampton last week and is hard to side against turned out under a penalty with Henry Callan now in the saddle. Recent Newcastle scorer West Sleekburn Lad could emerge as the main danger with this step up in trip a likely positive, although both Beaune and Stitching Wheel can also play a prominent role in this competitive amateur riders handicap.

  1. ZAFAAN (IRE)
  2. WEST SLEEKBURN LAD
  3. BEAUNE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bookmaker Comparison EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not much form to go on and it could pay to side with the well-related Iffraaj filly LADY'S GRACE to make a winning start. Jahami seems sure to build on a promising debut third at Newcastle and rates a big threat, while Thespian Queen could also play a part if shrugging off a lesser effort at Goodwood.

  1. LADY'S GRACE
  2. JAHAMI
  3. THESPIAN QUEEN

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bet Smarter Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
PIAZZA arrives better than ever and is taken to double her tally on the back of a very good Wolverhampton second when beaten just a head having been forced wide on the home turn. Lightly-raced Kempton winner Encore rates a big threat going into handicaps for the first time for William Haggas, while the consistent pair Korbut and Crafty Blue also need factoring in.

  1. PIAZZA
  2. ENCORE (FR)
  3. KORBUT

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Top UK Bookmakers EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ENGRAVED found the jump up to listed class too tough an ask at Doncaster last time and James Fanshawe's charge is taken to belatedly confirm debut promise by getting off the mark here. One For Bruce started well when third at Newmarket and appeals as the chief threat with progress very much on the cards, although newcomers Unerring and Sayaarr could also have a say, especially if the market speaks in their favour.

  1. ENGRAVED
  2. ONE FOR BRUCE
  3. UNERRING (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bet Smarter Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
INSUSPENSE was quick to make her mark for the switch to Ross Burdon over C&D last time and can make light of a 5 lb rise given she was well on top at the finish. Recent Newcastle scorer Storm Esme appeals as the one to chase her home, with Black Orchid completing the shortlist.

  1. INSUSPENSE
  2. STORM ESME
  3. BLACK ORCHID

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Racing Offers Handicap
races.verdict:
Multiple C&D scorer POPULAR DREAM signalled he is ready to strike again on his second run back after an absence when fifth over C&D on Saturday so looks the way to go. Khabib also has winning form over C&D and is feared most on the back of a good Newcastle third, while in-form duo Tommie's Angel and Jungle Dance need factoring in too.

  1. POPULAR DREAM
  2. KHABIB (IRE)
  3. TOMMIE'S ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Your Betting Guide Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
AFFETTUOSO looked a different model on the back of being gelded when a wide-margin winner at Lingfield and can follow up now stepping into handicap company for the first time. Nochebuena wasn't seen to anything like best effect at Doncaster last time and appeals as the chief threat to Roger Varian's improver ahead of Now Maybe.

  1. AFFETTUOSO
  2. NOCHEBUENA
  3. NOW MAYBE (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Each Way Extra Places Handicap
races.verdict:
HE'S OUR CRACKER had a bit up his sleeve when resuming winning ways at Newcastle last week and is fancied to follow up under a penalty at the chief expense of Risen Again who could bounce back now sporting cheekpieces again. Fleur de Mer is a very long time without a victory but weighted to go well if shrugging off a lesser effort at Catterick.

  1. HE'S OUR CRACKER (IRE)
  2. RISEN AGAIN (FR)
  3. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)

races.name: Tote Always SP Or Better At Galway Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
YOUNG REBEL will benefit from a stiffer test but he made an encouraging start for his new connections in a stronger event here 2 months ago and this could be a good opening for him. Baila Conmigo got back on track at Downpatrick and can go well for his in-form yard. Mister Class looks the pick of the newcomers.

  1. YOUNG REBEL (IRE)
  2. BAILA CONMIGO (IRE)
  3. MISTER CLASS (FR)

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
INTHENICKOFTIME made it 2 wins from 2 starts at this course when taking a big-field handicap last month and the runner-up has already franked that form. He makes plenty of appeal. Hello Garda and Just For One can also make their presence felt.

  1. INTHENICKOFTIME (IRE)
  2. HELLO GARDA (IRE)
  3. JUST FOR ONE (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Having turned a C&D handicap into a one-sided affair last month, MOONSHINE GIRL hadn't been fully asked for her effort when slipping up at Listowel 11 days ago. Returned to this venue, she can get back on the up. Fire Coral won that aforementioned race and she will doubtless give it another good go, while Western Shores is a potential improver for her leading yard.

  1. MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE)
  2. FIRE CORAL
  3. WESTERN SHORES (IRE)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Shop At Galway Racecourse Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
An interesting race and with this trip looking more suitable for CAPTAIN RYAN MATT than the Willie Mullins-trained pair Road To Home (sets a useful standard) and Chart Topper, he could be the answer sent chasing.

  1. CAPTAIN RYAN MATT (IRE)
  2. ROAD TO HOME (IRE)
  3. CHART TOPPER (FR)

races.name: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
ONEFORTHEDITCH made the frame in her last 2 starts over fences and her prominent style of racing should be suited to this track. She gets the nod. Dunany Point and Dearg Mor are also of interest.

  1. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE)
  2. DUNANY POINT (IRE)
  3. DEARG MOR (IRE)

races.name: Mongey Communications Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HEES DYNAMITE finished with running left under an inexperienced rider at Listowel last time and remains well treated on his hurdles form. He gets the vote with Darragh O'Keeffe up now. Ballagh Star was another eyecatcher at Sligo last week and demands respect off 2 lb lower. Thursday's Clonmel hurdles winner Mount Shenshan and Juke Hill are also respected.

  1. HEES DYNAMITE (IRE)
  2. BALLAGH STAR (IRE)
  3. MOUNT SHENSHAN (IRE)

races.name: Race In Pink On October 25th Flat Race
races.verdict:
WAY WITH WORDS produced a promising first effort when runner-up to a now useful sort at Leopardstown in March and has to be considered the one to beat on that form. Ellen Imlach is a noteworthy newcomer from a top stable, while Birdie Conway caught the eye finishing with running left in a valuable event at Punchestown on her debut and also enters calculations.

  1. WAY WITH WORDS (IRE)
  2. ELLEN IMLACH (FR)
  3. BIRDIE CONWAY (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Haras Du Ma Maiden Stakes
Prix Palluat De Besset Maiden Stakes
Prix Guillaume De Pracomtal Handicap Hurdle
Prix Pierre Et Jean-marie Mercier Chase
